vers.interpretation: Per-db_change row 16-bit stamp, not DBC v6 format version. 3569 equals current installed tad. DBDAT header version and dominates user archives. The official file's first 3,000 rows are mostly 3507, but all 16,024 rows are modal 3569; older stamps coexist in order. Evidence supports a retained per-change source/database-build stamp, but does not map every value to a named release or prove editor validation behavior.

rdui.semantic_distinction: DBC db_changes.rdui is a random-like per-change value; table_21.dat rdui is the row ordinal. Same field code, different enclosing structures.

addr.outer_duni_note: This is ADDR operation-envelope identity, not the identity of the newly added database record.

allocator_defaults.caveat: Defaults are specific to this read-only corpus. Supply complete per-table seen_duni/seen_rdui for another base DB; types 1/person and 3/club are explicitly incomplete because their installed row-ID layouts were not decoded.

limitations: The actual editor RNG/seed for DBC change rdui was not recovered; provider returns a fresh collision-checked candidate in the observed positive range, not a byte-identical historical draw.
Person/club installed DBID high-water marks were not independently recovered; their ADDR blocks are contiguous but starting high-water marks remain inferred.
Competition ADDR IDs contain gaps and two 64-bit duni exceptions; intervening ID reservations are absent from the sampled corpus.
The editor's load-time validation of vers/rdui was not executed; no game/editor was launched.
